title: Application-level lint rules
summary: Whole-program lint rules: TLS checks off, UI calls in console/service apps, DUnitX tests without asserts, weak ciphers, asm without Win64, GUI WriteLn
intro: Read this to see what each application-level rule reports, which ship ON or OFF, and how the checks avoid the common false positives (writeln-in-gui-app and ui-call-in-console-or-service ask the program: its .dpr directives and .dproj DCC_ConsoleTarget decide console or GUI). Since 1.56 ui-call-in-console-or-service also follows methods across units, by resolved call edges, from a console program main block or a TService descendant method (8 hops, cycle-guarded) and names the chain in the message; it needs an index (lint-all).
